ads-and-tracking.title: Ads & Tracking
ads-and-tracking.description: Ads and trackers with few false positives. Start here.

ads-and-tracking-extended.title: Ads & Tracking (Extended)
ads-and-tracking-extended.description: Aggressive ad, tracker, telemetry and pop-up blocking. Blocks more, may need occasional allowlisting.

mobile-ads.title: Mobile Ads
mobile-ads.description: Ad networks used inside Android and iOS apps.

mobile-spyware.title: Mobile Spyware & Telemetry
mobile-spyware.description: Phone-maker and app telemetry/tracking (Apple, Samsung, Xiaomi, Huawei, Oppo/Realme, Vivo, TikTok) plus Android trackers.

youtube-ads.title: YouTube Ads
youtube-ads.description: Google/YouTube ad servers. Partial: DNS cannot block all YouTube video ads (see note below).

gambling.title: Gambling
gambling.description: Online casinos, sports betting, poker, lotteries and other gambling sites.

adult.title: Adult Content
adult.description: Porn and other adult (NSFW) sites (see Safe Search tip below).

social-media.title: Social Media
social-media.description: Social networks: Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, X/Twitter, Snapchat, Reddit, LinkedIn, Pinterest, Tumblr, Threads, Bluesky, Discord and more. WhatsApp is not blocked.

smart-tv.title: Smart TV & Streaming Devices
smart-tv.description: Tracking and ads on smart TVs and streaming sticks (Samsung, LG webOS, Roku, Amazon Fire).

security.title: Security (Malware, Phishing, Scams)
security.description: Malware, phishing, scams and fake shops from threat-intelligence feeds. Recommended for everyone.

crypto-mining.title: Crypto Mining (Cryptojacking)
crypto-mining.description: Hidden crypto-mining scripts and mining pools (cryptojacking). Exchanges like Coinbase/Binance are not blocked.

phishing-and-scams.title: Phishing & Scams
phishing-and-scams.description: Phishing sites (fake bank, PayPal, Microsoft and delivery logins), scams and fake shops. Already included in `security`; use this if you only want phishing/scam protection.
